enrichment method: biotinylated LINC00955 was used as an RNA probe in RNA pull-down assays and mass spectrometry analyses
fractionation method: The gels were stained for 2 h in Coomassie brilliant blue staining solution, washed with ddH2O, and subjected to mass spectrometry.
labeling: We also identified an E3 ligase regulated by LINC00955 by quantitative proteomic analysis.
